decision.rationale: Adopt the corrected interpretation and safeguards, but keep automated pedagogy ineligible. Repeat agreement remains below 90%, swapped and cross-family sensitivity runs remain invalid, and no blinded human reference exists. The correction does not select a condition or open development or held-out execution.
limitations: The correction reanalyzes preserved aggregate artifacts and makes no model call.
The 48 repeat labels are clustered within two repeated cases and eight responses.
The original attempt-002 artifact predates per-input SHA-256 persistence.
Citation source correctness does not establish semantic entailment or completeness.
The human reference is deferred and contains zero completed judgments.
